[/list]

notes.title: Quest for Glory's creators are about to release their first visual novel
notes.notes: With the Quest for Glory series, Lori and Corey Cole pioneered a peanut-butter-and-chocolate hybrid of the RPG and adventure game that combined the best of both genres. The husband-and-wife duo had a shared background in tabletop roleplaying—which is how they met—and were inspired by the fluid way tabletop RPGs move between conversation, puzzle-solving, combat, and exploration. Though Sierra hired them to fill a gap when the studio lost the rights to publish the Ultima series, Quest for Glory ended up being a halfway point between the CRPGs of the day and Sierra's graphical adventures like King's Quest... Read more.

notes.title: Summer Daze at Hero-U sneak preview livestream with Lori and Corey Cole
notes.notes:
Our games have always pushed the limits of game genres. [i]Quest for Glory[/i] and [i]Shannara[/i] were adventure games that were also role-playing and storytelling games. [i]Castle of Dr. Brain[/i] brought together challenging word games, math puzzles, mazes, and more in entertaining ways. [i]Hero-U: Rogue to Redemption[/i] combined adventure gaming, role-playing, and a school simulation.

Now we're at it again with [i]Summer Daze at Hero-U,[/i] and as usual, it's hard to describe. That's why we'll be playing through part of the game to show you what it's all about! [i]Summer Daze[/i]  could be described as a visual novel, a "choices matter" game, an adventure game, a relationship game, or even a casual role-playing game.

Join us at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/transolargames]https://www.twitch.tv/transolargames[/url] on Saturday, June 20, 2020 at 2 pm PDT to experience [i]Summer Daze at Hero-U[/i] with the developers. We'll play through part of the game and talk about the development process and our plans for [i]Summer Daze[/i] and future games.

We'll also run some contests, play a bit of the [i]Quest for Infamy[/i] game that was inspired by [i]Quest for Glory,[/i] and try to find time for Lori to read from her young adult novel, [i]By the Book.[/i]

notes.title: Demo Patched!
notes.notes:
We’ve released an update to the demo, squashing some bugs and including our Kickstarter stretch goal of animated backgrounds. When you play the demo now, you’ll see the difference; clouds will move, flags will flutter in the wind, and characters will blink their eyes when they talk to you. The animations add more life to the game; we think they’re worth it.

The new demo also includes a preview of Ifeyo’s story. Ifeyo Kinah is a Wizard student, and his friends and teachers are quite different from Tilly’s. His familiar, the meerbat Jafafa, also accompanies him through much of the game!

If there are still bugs, don’t hesitate to tell us! Comment here, email [url=mailto:support@hero-u.net]support@hero-u.net[/url], or bring them up on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/7fGFD3v]Discord[/url] channel. We’re looking forward to getting the full game out soon!
